description: Firestorm Viewer Beta, the pre-release (Early Access) build

script: # Remove the NSIS installer's own files left over from extraction

notes: This is the AVX2 build, which needs a CPU from roughly 2013 or later.
Only the newest beta installer stays on Firestorm's download host, so an out-of-date copy of this manifest fails to download; run scoop update first.
Settings and chat logs live in %APPDATA%\Firestorm_x64, so they are shared with any other Firestorm install on this PC.
